outcome: prevalence of thyroid disorders in pregnancy
cesarean section rate for fetal distress
correlation between maternal and fetal TSH levels
cohort: 1055 pregnant women in their first and second trimesters
finding: This study found a high prevalence of thyroid dysfunction (36.5%) among pregnant women in India, with hypothyroidism linked to adverse pregnancy outcomes like hypertension, growth restriction, preterm birth, and cesarean deliveries, while hyperthyroidism was associated with neonatal respiratory distress and low APGAR scores.
